description: This file implements the OCIContainerImplementation class, which manages container lifecycle operations, event dispatching, and notification registration within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes methods for starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and querying containers, as well as handling container events and notifications.

classes.name: OCIContainerImplementation
classes.description: Class responsible for managing OCI container lifecycle, event dispatching, and notification handling within the plugin.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Handles the event when a container has started and dispatches the corresponding event.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Handles the event when a container has stopped and dispatches the corresponding event.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Handles the event when a container has failed and dispatches the corresponding event.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Handles the event when a container's state has changed and dispatches the corresponding event.
